ReturningSender re-describes an ACTIVE-CLASS returning item from the invocation: class-name -> that class ONLY (b 1.), SELF/SUPER -> ACTIVE-CLASS (b 2.), any other typed reference -> its own description (b 4.), FACTORY copied from the returning item; an interface-typed receiver yields universal (b 3.) - statically that arm cannot carry an ACTIVE-CLASS returning item, because 13.18.60.3 SR16 admits ACTIVE-CLASS only in a factory, instance or method definition, never a prototype.
